einzeiler: Fantasy football advice for Week 8 waiver wire pickups, trade watch, and quarterback…
kurzfassung: The hosts review Week 7 performances, discuss major injuries, and break down top waiver wire options for Week 8. They analyze potential landing spots for a high-profile running back amid ongoing trade rumors. Finally, they provide streaming recommendations for quarterbacks and defenses heading into the upcoming games.
stichpunkte: Analyzing Week 7 game outcomes, standout player performances, and mounting injuries across the league
Reviewing top waiver wire running back targets led by Jonah Coleman, Rico Dowdle, and Rashad White
Evaluating rookie wide receiver options and potential breakout candidates like Antonio Williams and Jacoby Lane
Discussing trade rumors surrounding Jonathan Taylor and potential landing spots for the star running back
Highlighting tight end waiver targets, including TJ Hockenson and favorable matchups
Identifying running back and wide receiver drop candidates for fantasy rosters
Providing quarterback streaming recommendations for Week 8 featuring Geno Smith, Sam Darnold, and Jacoby Brissett
Recommending top defensive streamer options for the week, including Jacksonville and New England
